scope:
CPU integer representation checks, NOT execution of SplitZip's GPU codec.

Exercises the published bit decomposition over every 16-bit word and executes
only the donor's actual compressed_bytes property with size-only objects.
Synthetic byte distributions are not target KV samples.
payload_formula: ceil(N/2) + N + 7*M, N=int16 words; excludes construction scratch, codebook ownership and serving integration

synthetic_cases.meaning: Donor size accounting on constructed bytes; not target compression ratio
Donor size accounting on constructed bytes; not target compression ratio

conclusion: No blanket byte-exactness veto; no target compressibility evidence. Public codec has whole-buffer decoding, BF16-facing API and dynamic escape extraction.
